title: stenanthemum pumilum
intro: Stenanthemum pumilum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant native to Western Australia, is a member of the family Ericaceae. It has been traditionally used to support immune function and may offer relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and colds, due to its potential health benefits.
